answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding every identity to bonded collateral and an auditable accountability record: when k coordinated identities equivocate, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), while detecting a controlled swarm applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier e^(αk), compounded by asymmetric depreciation. Thus a lagoon of ferrous keys or sable aliases cannot cheaply evade correlated evidence; splitting control increases expected loss instead of reducing it.
